Keeping a promise to Bella

By: Tarryn Crossman | Commission

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
Six months ago, Govan Whittles flew to the Eastern Cape to meet Isabella Esterhuyse — a little girl who had captured the hearts of the nation when she ran onto the field during the final game of the Rugby Championships.

At the time, Bella was in the thick of a brutal fight against cancer, enduring up to five rounds of chemotherapy a day. But in that moment on the field, she reminded South Africa what courage looks like.

Govan sat on the bedroom floor, speaking to her as if she were his daughter. They connected instantly. Before he left, he made her a promise: When you get better, I’ll come back and we’ll play rugby together.

A few weeks ago, Bella completed her aggressive chemotherapy treatment. She was given the all-clear, and she’s back at school.

Now, Govan is returning to the Eastern Cape to keep his promise.
